parsed.name: TOPTICA iBeam 智能二极管激光器
parsed.description: TOPTICA iBeam 是一款紧凑型智能二极管激光光源，可通过串口控制激光开关和输出功率，并读取实际输出状态。它常用于显微镜激发照明、光学实验以及需要稳定连续激光输出的实验室场景。
parsed.description_en: The TOPTICA iBeam is a compact smart diode laser source with serial control for laser on/off operation, output power setting, and status readback. It is commonly used for microscope excitation, optical experiments, and other laboratory applications requiring stable continuous laser output.

actions.description: 发送原始设备命令并读取激光器返回结果。
actions.description_en: Send a raw device command and read the laser's reply.

actions.description: 开启激光驱动，使激光器输出激光。
actions.description_en: Turn on the laser driver to enable laser output.

actions.description: 关闭激光驱动，停止激光输出。
actions.description_en: Turn off the laser driver to stop laser output.

actions.description: 设置正常工作通道的激光输出功率。
actions.description_en: Set the laser output power for the normal operating channel.

actions.description: 获取当前实际激光输出功率。
actions.description_en: Get the current actual laser output power.

actions.description: 获取激光驱动的开关状态。
actions.description_en: Get the on/off status of the laser driver.

actions.description: 获取激光器可用的最大输出功率。
actions.description_en: Get the maximum available output power of the laser.
